title: Layout-first dashboard prototype and trace hooks (planning notes)
summary: Working notes for a layout-first dashboard prototype that prioritizes operator workflows. Includes metric derivation, trace hook placement, widget liveness rules, and quick rollout checklist.
background: We get regular feedback that dashboards are noisy and slow to use during incidents. Operators need a predictable starting layout that surfaces root-cause signals quickly (kv-cache heat, tail latencies, model fallback rates). This doc sketches a prototype that binds layout decisions to tracing anchors and lightweight metric contracts.
goals: 1) Design a minimal set of widgets that answer the operator's first three questions on a token-serving incident. 2) Ensure every widget links to trace anchors. 3) Keep query cost under budget for 95% incidents. 4) Provide a rollout plan that is reversible.
metric_definitions:
operator_likely_root_signals:
- kvcache_warmth_percent: percent of requests served from KV cache (p50/p95) with tag tenant_id
- token_tail_latency_ms: tail latency for token generation (p95/p99) broken out by model_variant
- fallback_rate_pct: percent of requests that fell back to cheaper/safer model variant
- active_batch_size: distribution of batch sizes in serving runtime (mean, p90)
- model_load_time_ms: model load durations for cold starts
- probe_success_rate: synthetic probe success fraction per region
- query_cost_per_min: estimated query cost in $ per minute (derived from token counts and model unit cost)
Contract: all metrics must document "owner", "calculation_sql/snippet", "expected_horizon", "cardinality_tags".
trace_instrumentation_notes:
Trace anchors should map to the dashboard widgets. Example mappings:
- kvcache_warmth_percent -> trace span: serving.kvlookup (tag: cache_hit|cache_miss)
- token_tail_latency_ms -> span: runtime.token_emit with attribute: seq_len and model_variant
- fallback_rate_pct -> span: routing.fallback.reason and upstream_model_id
Sampling: adaptive sampling where incidents increase sampling to 100% for spans with fallback=true. Add a light-weight breadcrumb span at user-request boundary (user.ctx) to help sessionization. Ensure spans emit tenant.id but respect PII redaction policy.
dashboard_layout_notes:
Layout-first rules:
- Top-left: Incident header (time window, SLO burn, quick links to runbook)
- Row A: latency + kv-warmth heatmap (region x model)
- Row B: fallback rate sparkline + top 5 fallback reasons table (trace link per row)
- Row C: batch size distribution + probe success rate panel
- Panel behavior: each panel provides a direct link to filtered traces (time window + tenant + model_variant)
Widget liveness rules:
- If panel query cost > threshold, switch panel to summary mode (coarser granularity) and surface a cost icon. Operators can toggle live mode for a panel.
rollout_checklist:
- Create prototype dashboard in staging and attach trace links (owner: Ethan)
- Run a synthetic incident and validate trace-to-panel link accuracy (owner: Lina)
- Add metric contracts to metric registry and mark owners (owner: Priya)
- Run query-cost simulation for typical incident windows and set panel thresholds (owner: Diego)
- Ship feature flag gated to ops team, run 2-week pilot, collect feedback
- Rollback plan: feature flag off + revert dashboard changes in single PR
SLO for rollout: no increase in dashboard query cost > 5% vs current baseline during pilot.
open_questions:
- How to surface multi-tenant noise: aggregate vs per-tenant lanes?
- Which fallback reasons are stable enough to be first-class in the UI?
- Do we implement server-side trace link generation or client-side URL builder?
- Can we get a cost estimate for enabling 100% trace sampling during a 10-minute window?
decisions:
- Prototype will default to aggregated views with a tenant filter on the header (decision date: 2026-02-18)
- Trace sampling: adaptive by severity + fallback flag; full sampling only for triggered incidents
- Metric contract template endorsed: fields = owner, query, tags, expected_horizon
- Widget liveness: summary mode auto-enabled when panel cost exceeds 0.75x budget

notes_to_self: Keep prototype intentionally small. Focus on one model family and two regions for pilot. Capture operator feedback in #ops-dashboard-feedback. Avoid premature optimization of visual polish.
